description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'UpdateCatalogItemRequest' used for updating catalog items in the API. It inherits from 'BaseRequest' and contains properties like Id, CatalogBrandId, CatalogTypeId, Description, Name, PictureBase64, PictureUri, PictureName, and Price, with validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemRequest
classes.description: A request DTO for updating catalog item details in the eShop web API, including validation attributes for property validation.
